name: phenome-link
description: The VS Code end of a Grasshopper canvas: session status, the live journal, canvas recipes and script editing over loopback HTTP.

commands.title: Phenome Link: Insert Grasshopper Canvas Recipe
Phenome Link: Teach Agents in This Workspace

phenomeLink.reportTo.description: Where 'Report a Problem' addresses its mail draft. Empty uses the plugin's own intake address. Nothing is ever sent automatically - the draft opens in your mail client for you to read and send.

phenomeLink.agentCommand.description: The command that starts an agent session when pairing with Grasshopper; the handshake prompt is appended as one quoted argument. Left as 'claude', the command is resolved automatically: PATH first, then the CLI bundled inside the Claude Code extension. Set a full path or a different agent CLI to override.
